notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1d
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1.0.1d
Fixed an issue that unlocked multiple achievements when starting a new game

Fixed an issue that forced the player's sprint when starting a new game

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1c
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1.0.1c
Implemented several performance improvements especially when other characters appear

Updated the emergency lights and the #Anomaly03

Updated several plants and water decorative elements

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1b
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1.0.1b
Fixed several issues in #Anomaly04, #Anomaly29 and #Anomaly38

Fixed an issue in the new game loading menu that caused interface problems

Fixed an issue with several suitcases in different hallways

Fixed an issue when starting a new game that generated the last anomaly you had seen in the previous game

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.1

Minor fixes
Fixed an issue in #Anomaly34 when playing #BlackoutMode

Fixed a mouse issue in the escape menu

Fixed an issue in #Anomaly05 when playing #MadnessMode

Fixed an issue that prevented #MadnessMode from being playable even after escaping in the other game modes

Fixed an issue that prevented matches from starting correctly when clicking the #NewGame button while playing #MadnessMode

Fixed the name of an achievement in Spanish


Major fixes and additions
Added a more detailed explanation of how the game mechanics work during the loading screen, which also lets you view the different hallways

Added game instructions to the escape menu

Improved the options system for better performance, especially resolution settings

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0b
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.0b
Fixed an issue in #Anomaly51 

Fixed an issue with one of the doors in #Hallway02

Updated the signs and decals
